Hint: UK is a country; Male actors mean that a_gender = 'M'; Female actors mean that a_gender = 'F'; ratio; ratio of gender in actors = count(a_gender = 'M') / a_gender = 'F'
sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.a_gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN a.a_gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM movies m
JOIN movies2actors ma ON m.movieid = ma.movieid
JOIN actors a ON ma.actorid = a.actorid
WHERE m.country = 'UK';
